title: Box Jump
summary: An explosive jump onto a box. It's for power, not size: the muscle stimulus is low, but it trains rate of force.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: plyo box or sturdy box.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.55 for quads (helper): each working set adds 0.55 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.5 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.4 for calves (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly calves total.
Library rating 0.2 for hamstrings: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly hamstrings total.

setup.text: Stand a short step from the box.
Swing your arms and jump up, landing softly with bent knees.

form_cues.cue: A higher box isn't the goal. Land quietly.

mistakes.text: Picking a box so high you land in a deep squat.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
